metadata.title: Palantir Stock’s 25% Rally Just Ended as Shares Close Lower<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Palantir Stock’s 25% Rally Hits the Brakes as Shares Close Lower
Palantir Technologies stock fell Wednesday, bringing its seven-day winning streak to a screeching halt.
